== Biography ==

=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-752]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The 1860/1870 ages and West Marlborough locality bridge that relationship to her earlier family identity despite the ordinary Amy/Anny/Annie variation.

Held citation and associated historical narrative address this selected father-child identity; no original was newly inspected.
